instruction: Candid action photograph, medium full shot. Inside an indoor boxing gym, the dark-skinned boxer in red shorts (R2) stands on the right with his back to the camera, pressing forward into a clinch. On the left, the light-skinned boxer in black shorts (R1) crouches defensively with his head down. The action is framed through the black ropes of the boxing ring under bright overhead lighting.
